scope: A restructure destroyed contract history it does not own. The rebuild enumerated the segments it knew (CL/TCV/AAV/Y-tokens/GTD) and dropped everything else, so `Ext:` — the record of which franchises have spent an extension on a player, which gates future extension eligibility — vanished from nine contracts restructured through this form in 2026 (Cook, Hurts, Love, Achane, London, Collins, Rice, Nacua, Robinson; backfilled 2026-08-22). FO v2 was the ONLY writer missing it: roster_workbench.js and the mobile submitter both already re-pushed the token. Inverted the rule — the rebuild now names the segments it OWNS and carries every other one through verbatim, which also rescues the tag quartet (Tag | Tier N | Formula: … | 10% salary floor) that a restructure of a tagged player would have silently destroyed. Same class as the AAV and -FL/-BL losses in 2.0.9. Also normalized the tag floor annotation: the strip regex matched "10% salary floor" while the writer emitted "10% AAV floor", so it never matched its own output and re-tagging appended forever (Javonte Williams carried it twice live). All three writers now strip either wording and every occurrence, then emit one canonical TAG_FLOOR_NOTE — "10% AAV floor (rounded up to $1K)", accurate per canon C8-A since the floor is AAV-only. Mobile had been writing the stale salary-inclusive label.
